Settings
Team
Choose who is a coordinator and which wing each person belongs to. A coordinator manages their wing (dashboard, exams, reports, batch lists) and can force a check-out, but does not teach.
Tap a wing above to see its teachers.
Phone notifications
Alerts that reach a teacher's phone even when the app is closed. Each teacher turns them on once, on the Today page.
Teacher Mapping
The usual teacher for each subject (and batch). The timetable fills the teacher in automatically.
Tap a wing above to set the teachers of its subjects and batches.
Class / Batch List
Edit the batches every teacher picks from when logging a class or setting up their weekly schedule.
Tap a wing above to see and manage its classes.
Shift
Tap a shift above to see its batches.
Periods & Timings
Period times for each timetable (Pre-Foundation Morning, Evening…).
Subjects
The subject list teachers and exams choose from.
Tap a wing above to see and manage its subjects.
Rooms
Rooms and halls used for exams and the duty plan.
Test Types
Shown when teachers log invigilation and when you add an exam.
Weekly Off
On these days a teacher with no activity shows as "Weekly off" (not Absent), and their report says WEEKLY OFF.
AI (beta)
Only you see this. Paste the address of your AI helper (the Cloudflare Worker) and test it. Teachers see nothing of AI until a feature is switched on.
AI helper address
Coordinators and AI
A Coordinator can use “Fill from a photo” once their login email is added in Cloudflare → your Worker → Settings → Variables → ADMIN_EMAILS (keep yours, put a comma, then theirs).
Campus Location
Used to check that teachers are on campus when they check in.
Not set yet.
Campus radius (metres)
Now: 250 metres (starting value). You can set 50 to 2000 metres.
If that doesn't work (common inside embedded apps), enter coordinates manually — open Google Maps, long-press your campus location, and copy the numbers shown.
Director Contact
Teachers can reach out from their Menu → Contact Director. Leave blank to hide a field.

It follows Settings → Class reminders (the switch and the minutes you choose there). While the app is open you hear the app's own reminder, so no phone notification comes at that time.
Birthday wish: a message at 7:30 AM on your birthday (add your birthday in Profile).

How to use
Check in and outTap the button on the Today tab when you arrive and when you leave campus.
Add a classUse "+ Class": pick the batch, timing, chapter and topic, and mark what you gave (worksheet / DPP, test, homework).
Add an activityFor anything that isn't a class, like meetings, leave or other work.
HistorySee any past day, week or month, class by class.
ReportsDownload or share a report (PDF, WhatsApp or Excel). Admin and Coordinator find it in History.
ScheduleSet weekly class reminders and keep personal photos for quick reference.

About
CATJEE Teach Desk

A daily activity tracker built for CATJEE's teachers and admin team.

Your data is stored securely on Google Firebase. Only you and your institute's admins can see your activity.
